item.title: [Notice] Decentralized Frontends & Infra
item.dc:creator: BlockswapDAO
item.description:
[Update]

Following the previous notice in March, please note that all hosted services will be deprecated as of July 10th, 2024. Labs extended the availability of hosted services for a period of time to help the community become familiar with the decentralized infrastructure utilities of the network for self deployment.
Furthermore, the deprecation will also result in discontinuing all managed support for users from Labs.

IPFS hosted information on dApps and UI; refer to the notice on Dec 2023: [Notice] IPFS Hosted Blockswap Network dApps and UI

The network is fully decentralized and in self-autonomous mode with an onchain Blockswap DAO - Address 0x8869A94df9200C75116A285e12E85C24179129E1 | Etherscan
Address: 0x8869A94df9200C75116A285e12E85C24179129E1
